title: What queues a provider sign-out
assertion: The database writes one `provider_sign_out` row for each ended membership, recorded reset (completed, or of unknown outcome) and confirmed key removal, in the cause's own transaction, once an event, and none for a rolled-back cause or any other action; the row carries the account, the reason, the event and the request ID, never an address or a provider subject
noFileReason: Synthetic accounts and a provider twin the tests make; no file.
